payload.description_html:
Aeduella blainvillei (Agassiz, 1833) - fossil fish in shale from the Permian of France. (FMNH P25043, Field Museum of Natural History, Chicago, Illinois, USA)

Also known as Amblypterus blainvillei.

Classification: Animalia, Chordata, Vertebrata, Osteichthyes, Actinopterygii, Aeduelliformes, Aeduellidae

Stratigraphy: Muse Formation, Lower Permian

Locality: unrecorded/unspecified site at or near the town of Muse, northeast of Autun, east-central France
